description: ABC from `collections.abc`. Implement `__getitem__`, `__setitem__`, `__delitem__`, `__iter__` and `__len__` to receive `get`, `pop`, `update`, `setdefault`, `items`, `__eq__` and more.
Methods an ABC provides on top of the abstract ones you implement.
C-implemented methods like `update` and `setdefault` do not call your overridden `__setitem__`, so custom rules can be bypassed.
Mapping keys to a canonical form (for example lowercase) at the boundary so lookups ignore irrelevant differences.
